evaluation: Posthoc comparison of one ordinary Error on the exact snapshots before and after an independent review correction. The existing three-case release check has its own results and denominator.

snapshotVerification.initial: Reconstructed from the original changes to the handler and its test. Rehashing the complete Git tree matched the snapshot recorded at the first review and check.
snapshotVerification.final: Matched the delivered, committed tree named by its provenance and the correction review.

execution: Same ordinary Error scenario in separate isolated JavaScript realms with the recorded TypeScript toolchain and a callback spy. No application process, external dependencies, or network traffic.
